speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, we are here at the All In Summit at an amazing trailer that Brad Gerstner brought.
zh: 好的，我们现在在 All In Summit 现场，在 Brad Gerstner 带来的一辆很棒的拖车里。

speaker: Unknown
en: You bought this how long ago?
zh: 你买这个多久了？

speaker: Unknown
en: About a year ago.
zh: 大约一年前。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, so Brad, tell us what we're standing in front of.
zh: 好，Brad，跟我们讲讲我们现在站在什么前面。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, so we're standing in front of a mobile calcium CT scanner.
zh: 是这样，我们现在站在一辆移动式钙化 CT 扫描仪前。

speaker: Unknown
en: So most of, you know, the folks who followed us on both the All In Pod, the BG2 Pod, etc., know that one of the moonshots I'm working on
zh: 大多数关注过 All In 播客、BG2 播客等的朋友们都知道，我正在推进的登月计划之一

speaker: Unknown
en: is we have 800,000 people die in this country every year from heart disease.
zh: 是这个国家每年有 80 万人死于心脏病。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the number one killer in the world.
zh: 它是世界头号杀手。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we turn the calcium CT scan into the mammogram for the heart, we will save 50,000 lives a year.
zh: 如果我们把钙化 CT 扫描变成心脏的乳腺钼靶检查，我们每年将挽救 5 万条生命。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's like ending a Ukraine war every year in the United States.
zh: 这相当于在美国每年终结一场乌克兰战争的死亡规模。

speaker: Unknown
en: It will save the government $20 billion in care for people.
zh: 它将为政府节省 200 亿美元的医疗照护开支。

speaker: Unknown
en: But most importantly, we're losing our most important friends, brothers, dads,
zh: 但最重要的是，我们正在失去我们最重要的朋友、兄弟、父亲，

speaker: Unknown
en: At the prime of their life in something that's totally preventable.
zh: 在他们人生的黄金时期，死于一种完全可预防的疾病。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this has a calcium CT scanner in it.
zh: 这辆拖车里装着一台钙化 CT 扫描仪。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've had hundreds of people coming through here.
zh: 已有数百人来这里做过扫描。

speaker: Unknown
en: We found scores over the last two days that most definitely have saved people's lives.
zh: 过去两天我们发现了好几十个病例，可以肯定地说是挽救了一些人的生命。

speaker: Unknown
en: It costs $100 and it takes 15 minutes.
zh: 扫描费用是 100 美元，耗时 15 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I lost my father too early and my good friend here, Rob Goldberg, I want you to hear from him.
zh: 我自己也是过早失去了父亲，我身边这位好朋友 Rob Goldberg，我想让你们听听他的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this is the type of moonshot that we need to have.
zh: 但这正是我们需要的那种登月计划。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're working with Washington.
zh: 我们正在与华盛顿合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want to get this covered by insurance so that we get 40 million people to take the scan.
zh: 我们希望让保险覆盖这项检查，这样我们就能让 4000 万人去做扫描。

speaker: Unknown
en: Mammograms, which are super important in this country, we have 40 million a year.
zh: 乳腺钼靶检查在这个国家非常重要，我们每年有 4000 万人次。

speaker: Unknown
en: CAC scans, which is the number one killer, we have one million a year.
zh: 而 CAC 扫描，针对头号杀手的检查，我们每年只有 100 万人次。

speaker: Unknown
en: We need to have 40 million CAC scans in this country every year.
zh: 我们需要这个国家每年有 4000 万人次的 CAC 扫描。

speaker: Unknown
en: But Rob, we're going to do a tag team pod here.
zh: Rob，我们要在这里做一个接力播客。

speaker: Unknown
en: You are a key inspiration.
zh: 你是一个关键的灵感来源。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your family was a key inspiration for me in wanting to do this, along with Jason Chang and the rest of the besties.
zh: 你的家人是我想做这件事的关键灵感来源，还有 Jason Chang 和其他 besties。

speaker: Unknown
en: Talk a little bit about, you know, how this touched your family.
zh: 聊一聊这件事是如何影响到你的家庭的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Brad, thank you.
zh: Brad，谢谢你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And thank you and Jason for doing this and for you showcasing it.
zh: 也谢谢你和 Jason 做这件事，还有你来展示它。

speaker: Unknown
en: My unfortunate, you know, connection to this is that my brother and I and a number of our friends were on vacation for a friend's 50th birthday, another bestie, Phil Deutsch, and we, in the afternoon, we saw him, we were all hanging out by the pool, and then at 6 o'clock, 6.30, couldn't find him.
zh: 我与此事的不幸关联是，我和我哥哥，还有我们的几位朋友，去为一个朋友的 50 岁生日度假，他也是一位 bestie，Phil Deutsch。那天下午我们还见过他，大家一起在泳池边消磨时光，然后到了 6 点、6 点半，找不到他了。

speaker: Unknown
en: My sister-in-law and I started looking for him and we unfortunately found him in the gym of the house, collapsed and my adrenaline was going so fast I couldn't tell if it was his heartbeat or mine so I just started doing CPR and we unfortunately brought him to the hospital and he'd been dead for hours because he had undiagnosed heart disease.
zh: 我嫂子和我就开始找他，不幸的是，我们在房子的健身房里发现了他，他已经倒下了。当时我的肾上腺素飙升太快，我都分不清那是他的心跳还是我的，所以我直接开始做心肺复苏，我们不幸地把他送到了医院，但他已经去世几个小时了，因为他患有未被诊断出的心脏病。

speaker: Unknown
en: These are folks.
zh: 这些人啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my sister-in-law is Sheryl Sandberg.
zh: 我嫂子是 Sheryl Sandberg。

speaker: Unknown
en: She wrote a book called Option B about his death and about grieving and top medical, concierge doctors.
zh: 她写过一本书叫 Option B，讲的是他的离世，以及悲伤疗愈，还有顶级的医疗、私人医生。

speaker: Unknown
en: He had actually passed.
zh: 其实他已经去世了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is a really important point.
zh: 所以这是一个非常重要的点。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my brother had passed a running EKG five months before he dropped dead from heart disease, from undiagnosed heart disease.
zh: 我哥哥在猝死于心脏病、未被诊断出的心脏病之前五个月，做过一次运动心电图（EKG）检查。

speaker: Unknown
en: Unfortunately, EKGs have a four percent either false positive or false negative where
zh: 不幸的是，心电图有百分之四的假阳性或假阴性，

speaker: Unknown
en: He had actually done so much cardio that he taught his heart to overcome the heart disease.
zh: 他实际上做了太多有氧运动，以至于他训练自己的心脏去克服了心脏病。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it was pumping harder and harder and harder.
zh: 所以它跳得越来越用力、越来越用力、越来越用力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then eventually, when we were in Mexico, it just stopped.
zh: 然后最终，当我们还在墨西哥的时候，它就停了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He died of ventricular arrhythmia.
zh: 他死于心室性心律失常。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was reports of, because we found him near, I gave the report, we found him next to the treadmill.
zh: 有报道说，因为是我们发现他的，是我做的报告，我们是在跑步机旁边发现他的。

speaker: Unknown
en: He did not fall off the treadmill and die.
zh: 他不是从跑步机上摔下来死的。

speaker: Unknown
en: He died of heart disease.
zh: 他是死于心脏病。

speaker: Unknown
en: And thankfully, due to Cheryl, due to Chamath, due to some other folks, we got him back to be able to do a full autopsy and found his heart disease.
zh: 所幸，多亏了 Cheryl，多亏了 Chamath，还有其他一些人，我们把遗体接了回来做了解剖，发现了他的心脏病。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's truly tragic, and it was completely unnecessary.
zh: 但这真的是一场悲剧，而且完全是可以避免的。

speaker: Unknown
en: He was 47.
zh: 他当时 47 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: My niece and nephew were 7 and 10.
zh: 我的侄女和侄子分别是 7 岁和 10 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're growing up without a biological father.
zh: 他们在没有生父的情况下长大。

speaker: Unknown
en: They have a great stepfather now.
zh: 他们现在有了一位很棒的继父。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's just complete, as Brad just said, we are losing people in the prime of their lives who have no need to die for something that is completely preventable and screenable.
zh: 但就像 Brad 刚刚说的,我们正在失去处于人生黄金时期的人,他们本来完全不必死于一种完全可以预防、完全可以筛查的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Dave was such a legend, so loved, the inspiration in many ways for All In and the Bestie group.
zh: 而且 Dave 是一个如此传奇的人物,如此受人爱戴,在很多方面是 All In 和 Bestie 群体的灵感来源。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, Chamath would say he was the original, you know, who got everybody together.
zh: 我是说,Chamath 会说,他是最初把大家聚在一起的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: He might have argued a few points with everyone on stage, but yes.
zh: 他可能和台上的每个人争论过一些观点,但没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: To get together for poker.
zh: 聚在一起打扑克。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so like what better, more fitting way to honor Dave
zh: 所以,还有什么比这更好、更合适的方式来纪念 Dave

speaker: Unknown
en: But also to take this and say, like, we can do something.
zh: 同时也借此说,我们是可以做点什么的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can be biased to action.
zh: 我们可以倾向于行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't have to sit here as though we can do nothing.
zh: 我们不必坐在这里,好像我们什么都做不了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have agency.
zh: 我们有主观能动性。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why aren't we doing 40 million CAC scans a year?
zh: 为什么我们每年不做 4000 万次 CAC 扫描?

speaker: Unknown
en: Why don't Americans know about this?
zh: 为什么美国人不知道这件事?

speaker: Unknown
en: Why are they all tracking their cholesterol and doing EKGs and thinking or, you know, doing stress tests and thinking they're totally fine, right?
zh: 为什么他们都在追踪自己的胆固醇、做 EKG、想着——或者你知道的——做压力测试,然后以为自己完全没事,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Like we've served people up some stuff that's just not accurate.
zh: 就像我们给人们提供的那些东西根本不准确。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this tells you dispositively, yes or no,
zh: 而这个检查能明确地告诉你,是或否,

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you have calcium in your arteries?
zh: 你的动脉里有没有钙化?

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is a precursor, your predisposition to build plaque.
zh: 这是一个前兆,是你形成斑块的易感倾向。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you don't have a heart attack if you don't have plaque.
zh: 如果你没有斑块,你就不会心脏病发作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Correct.
zh: 没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so to me this is, you know, we started the Center for Heart Attack Prevention and we have three missions with that.
zh: 所以对我来说,你知道,我们创办了心脏病发作预防中心,它有三个使命。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is awareness.
zh: 第一个是提高意识。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's doing this, right?
zh: 就是做这件事,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: It's bringing a trailer so that more people talk about it, more people know about it.
zh: 把拖车带过来,让更多人谈论它,让更多人知道它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I can tell you, while the scores are anonymous, we had scores from people who took their exam yesterday.
zh: 而且我可以告诉你,虽然评分是匿名的,昨天参加检查的人里有些人的评分

speaker: Unknown
en: that they are definitely in danger zone, right?
zh: 明显处于危险区域,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: And so these people- It's amazing.
zh: 所以这些人——这太了不起了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's the great thing.
zh: 好消息是。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's the great thing.
zh: 好消息是。

speaker: Unknown
en: A high score is not a decetence because you can do something about it.
zh: 高分不是判决书,因为你可以对此做点什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Heart attacks are almost totally preventable, right?
zh: 心脏病发作几乎完全可以预防,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not like brain cancer that we don't have a lot of treatment for.
zh: 不像脑癌那样我们没有太多治疗手段。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can do everything with statins, with azetamibes, et cetera.
zh: 我们可以用他汀类药物、用 azetamibes 等等做一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can lower your ApoB.
zh: 我们可以降低你的 ApoB。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can lower your LDLs and we can get you on a path to heart health.
zh: 我们可以降低你的 LDL,让你走上心脏健康的道路。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so number one is just awareness.
zh: 所以第一个使命就是提高意识。

speaker: Unknown
en: Number two is making this more accessible to people.
zh: 第二个是让更多人更容易获得这项检查。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we need to have changes in Washington that make this standard of care in the country.
zh: 所以我们需要在华盛顿推动变革,让这成为全国的标准护理。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cholesterol as a standard of care is ludicrous, right?
zh: 把胆固醇作为标准护理是荒谬的,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: We are way passive.
zh: 我们太被动了。

speaker: Unknown
en: How did we get to that?
zh: 我们是怎么走到这一步的?

speaker: Unknown
en: Why is cholesterol, how did cholesterol become the key marker?
zh: 为什么是胆固醇,胆固醇是怎么成为关键指标的?

speaker: Unknown
en: And like, where did we go so wrong?
zh: 而且,我们到底是在哪里错得这么离谱的?

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, you know, it's so interesting that Bill Gurley was here, okay?
zh: 我是说,你知道,真有意思,Bill Gurley 曾 经来过这里,好吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: And he is here somewhere.
zh: 他现在也在这里的某个地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: But Bill Gurley was here.
zh: Bill Gurley 来过这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's a regulatory capture.
zh: 他讲监管俘获。

speaker: Unknown
en: So 50 years ago, you know, heart health became a really national issue.
zh: 所以 50 年前,你知道,心脏健康成了一个真正的全国性议题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I believe it was Eisenhower who had a heart attack in the Oval Office.
zh: 我相信是艾森豪威尔在椭圆形办公室心脏病发作。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was a race in Silicon Valley to see who could solve heart health.
zh: 硅谷掀起了一场竞赛，看谁能解决心脏健康问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: One path that people went down was to invent the stent.
zh: 人们走的一条路是发明支架。

speaker: Unknown
en: The other one was the calcium CT scanner.
zh: 另一条路是钙化CT扫描仪。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who do you think won the lobby in Washington?
zh: 你觉得谁赢得了华盛顿的游说？

speaker: Unknown
en: The stent lobby won.
zh: 支架游说赢了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay?
zh: 好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So he said, don't worry.
zh: 所以他说，别担心。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cholesterol is good enough to track.
zh: 胆固醇已经够用，可以追踪。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what we already do.
zh: 那就是我们已经做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you have a heart condition, we'll solve it with a stent.
zh: 如果你有了心脏病，我们会用支架解决。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wrong.
zh: 错了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wrong answer.
zh: 错误的答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay?
zh: 好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So here we are many, many years later.
zh: 所以很多很多年过去了，我们到了今天。

speaker: Unknown
en: My father died too early from heart disease.
zh: 我父亲因心脏病去世得太早。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I hijacked a session, the Science Corner on the All In Podcast in 2022 is when I first started talking about this.
zh: 所以我在2022年劫持了一期节目，All In Podcast 的 Science Corner，那是我第一次开始谈论这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: And over the course of the last three to four years, we made amazing progress.
zh: 在过去三到四年里，我们取得了惊人的进展。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once I started talking about it, people went out and got their CACs and I started getting hundreds and then thousands of letters from my, you know, dear friends to total strangers saying you saved my life.
zh: 一旦我开始谈论这个，人们就去做 CAC 检查，我开始收到几百封、然后几千封来信，从我亲爱的朋友到完全陌生的人，说“你救了我的命”。

speaker: Unknown
en: I found that I had...
zh: 我发现我有过……

speaker: Unknown
en: I gave it for free at my Investor Day at the Rosewood Hotel on Sand Hill Road, and famous CEOs in Silicon Valley found 98% blockage and had three stents put in within three weeks of having the CAC done.
zh: 我在 Sand Hill Road 的 Rosewood 酒店我的投资者日上免费提供了这个检查，硅谷的知名 CEO 们发现了98%的堵塞，在做完 CAC 检查的三周内植入了三个支架。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this only costs $100.
zh: 所以这个只要100美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: We got a live audience here, so I'm talking to them.
zh: 我们这里有现场观众，所以我在对他们说。

speaker: Unknown
en: It only costs 100 bucks.
zh: 它只花100块钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's non-invasive.
zh: 它是无创的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can be done in 10 minutes.
zh: 10分钟就能做完。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the fact that people don't know about this, it's the highest ROI in healthcare, not only to the country, but to each of us and to our friends.
zh: 而人们竟然不知道这件事，这是医疗健康领域回报率最高的，不仅对国家，而且对我们每个人和我们的朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in our group, it's non-negotiable.
zh: 所以在我们的圈子里，这是不容商量的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody has to get this.
zh: 每个人都必须做这个检查。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I appreciate your interest in this.
zh: 所以我很感谢你对这个的关注。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I would finally just say, finish up on this.
zh: 但最后我只想说，就到这里收个尾。

speaker: Unknown
en: I say to my kids all the time, and this really inspired the Trump accounts as well, we can sit around, you know, at the All In Summit and we can talk about the problems, but we also, what do we do in Silicon Valley so well?
zh: 我经常对我的孩子们说，这也启发了 Trump 账户，我们可以坐在 All In Summit 上谈论问题，但我们在硅谷最擅长做的是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: We start movements, we start companies, we do things.
zh: 我们发起运动，我们创办公司，我们做事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have agency.
zh: 我们有主观能动性。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a biased action.
zh: 我们倾向于行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now we have a connection to Washington, D.C.
zh: 现在我们与华盛顿特区有了联系。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can bring these pillars of policy together along with pillars of action together and re-education that we do through podcasts and other things to help people help themselves.
zh: 所以你可以把这些政策支柱与行动支柱结合起来，再加上我们通过播客和其他方式进行的教育，帮助人们自助。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm really thrilled you were here today.
zh: 所以我非常高兴你今天来到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just want to thank Brad for having me.
zh: 我只是想感谢 Brad 邀请我。

speaker: Unknown
en: But more importantly, much more importantly, what Brad and Jason are doing, and Brad overall, whether it's Trump accounts, whether it's this, Brad is the epitome of
zh: 但更重要的是，重要得多的是，Brad 和 Jason 正在做的事，以及 Brad 整体上做的事，无论是 Trump 账户，还是这个，Brad 是……的典范

speaker: Unknown
en: You're putting words to action, thoughts to action, and passion to action.
zh: 你在把语言变成行动，把想法变成行动，把热情变成行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: I love having you out in the world doing more of what you're doing.
zh: 我喜欢你在这个世界上继续做更多你正在做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's amazing.
zh: 这太了不起了。

speaker: Unknown
en: My brother would love this, obviously, were he here.

speaker: Unknown
en: But what you continue to do, and you're doing it to help others.

speaker: Unknown
en: You have a day job, and it's a pretty important day job, and you're doing that one pretty well, too.
zh: 你有一份全职工作，而且是一份相当重要的全职工作，你把那份工作也做得相当好。
